result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the bottom tab bar contains a stray dark bar that overlaps the navigation icons and is not aligned to the active tab.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal bar sits in the bottom navigation between the Search and Orders icons, at the same height as the icons. It is not anchored under the active Home tab nor placed at the bottom edge like a system home indicator, so it reads as a detached element overlapping the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray bar or anchor the active-tab indicator beneath the Home icon, and inset the tab bar above the bottom safe area so no indicator overlaps the navigation icons.
